disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读了服务端入口与浏览器端包，检查硬编码密钥、访问 SSH/云凭据/钱包文件、批量搜集密钥的命令，均未检出。
checked_items.en: Read through the server entry point and browser-side package; checked for hardcoded credentials, access to SSH/cloud credentials/wallet files, and commands for bulk credential collection. None detected.

checked_items.zh: 服务端仅读取用户本机自选股配置文件（含股票代码与买卖目标价，非凭据），且只回传给同一用户的浏览器端；未发现向任何外部地址发送凭据的路径。
checked_items.en: The server only reads the user's local watchlist configuration file (containing stock codes and buy/sell target prices, not credentials) and only sends them back to the same user's browser side; no path for sending credentials to any external address was found.

checked_items.zh: 在整个源码树中搜索常见密钥格式与云厂商访问密钥特征，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire source tree for common credential patterns and cloud provider access key signatures; 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 检查了凭据读取面：插件未读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 密钥、云凭据或钱包文件；唯一读取的用户文件是自选股配置（index.js 中 ~/.stocking/settings.json），内容不含凭据。
evidence.en: Checked the credential read surface: the plugin does not read host credential files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, or wallet files; the only user file read is the watchlist configuration (`~/.stocking/settings.json` in `index.js`), which does not contain credentials.

checked_items.zh: 审查了服务端向模型上下文注入的两段条件式系统提示（「一键投资研究报告」与「每日复盘/行情分析/涨停分析」），内容为股票分析任务框架，仅在用户消息匹配对应关键词时生效，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed two conditional system prompts injected by the server into the model context ("One-click Investment Research Report" and "Daily Review/Market Analysis/Limit-up Analysis"), which are stock analysis task frameworks that only take effect when the user message matches the corresponding keywords. No instruction override, fake system message, or wording that induces credential reading was found.

checked_items.zh: 逐一通读了随包的两个技能文件及其工具脚本，内容为前端设计规范与投资研究框架，未发现隐藏指令或恶意行为。
checked_items.en: Read through each of the two skill files bundled with the package and their tool scripts; the content consists of frontend design specifications and an investment research framework. No hidden instructions or malicious behavior was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了说明文档、配置与代码注释等全部文本面，未发现要求模型忽略规则、伪造认证或执行越权动作的注入文本。
checked_items.en: Checked all text surfaces including documentation, configuration, and code comments; no injected text that instructs the model to ignore rules, forge authentication, or perform unauthorized actions was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未向宿主注册带描述的工具，仅注册数据路由；注入模型上下文的系统提示为条件式股票分析框架，语义审查未发现指令覆写、凭证诱导或越权指令。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register tools with descriptions to the host; it only registers data routes. The system prompts injected into the model context are conditional stock analysis frameworks; semantic review found no instruction override, credential solicitation, or unauthorized commands.

evidence.zh: 注入模型的提示词仅指示按分析框架做股票研究，不含诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: The prompts injected into the model only instruct it to perform stock research according to the analysis framework, and contain no wording that induces installing plugins, modifying configuration, or granting permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置：仅声明插入插件本体（插件 id 与名称），无任何可执行代码标签，也不存在挂载即执行代码的面。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch configuration: it only declares the insertion of the plugin body (plugin ID and name), with no executable code tags, and no surface for code execution upon mounting.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与脚本：主插件无动态执行（eval、动态函数构造、子进程）调用；本地测试脚本中的疑似命中实为浏览器自动化测试库的页面求值方法，非代码执行；股票数据文件为普通 JSON 数据，非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and scripts: the main plugin has no dynamic execution calls (eval, dynamic function construction, subprocess); the apparent hit in the local test script is actually a page evaluation method from the browser automation testing library, not code execution; the stock data file is plain JSON data, not obfuscated code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装配置：无安装后执行钩子；浏览器端仅在需要时从 CDN 加载固定版本的图表与动画库，无下载即执行远程载荷。
checked_items.en: Checked the installation configuration: no post-install hooks; the browser side only loads fixed-version chart and animation libraries from CDN when needed, no "download-and-execute" remote payload.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部 YAML 配置：挂载配置仅有一条插入声明，无任何可执行代码标签，不存在挂载即执行代码的面。
evidence.en: Checked all YAML configurations: the patch configuration only has one insertion declaration, with no executable code tags, and no surface for code execution upon mounting.

evidence.zh: 未发现对宿主动态执行工具（把代码塞进沙箱运行）的任何调用，插件自身代码也不含动态求值。
evidence.en: No calls to the host's dynamic execution tool (which runs code in the sandbox) were found, and the plugin's own code contains no dynamic evaluation.

evidence.zh: 无安装后执行钩子，无未锁定版本的 git 依赖；源码树内不存在提交钩子、CI 工作流、容器开发配置等可执行载体，本地测试脚本仅做界面验证，无恶意行为。
evidence.en: No post-install hooks, no unversioned git dependencies; no executable carriers such as commit hooks, CI workflows, or container development configurations exist in the source tree; the local test script only performs UI verification with no malicious behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端模块，已专项审查：仅注册右上角悬浮窗、读写本地配置、同源拉取行情，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、调用宿主凭据接口或异常外联。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side module, which has been specifically reviewed: it only registers a floating window in the top-right corner, reads/writes local configuration, and fetches market data from the same origin; no keyboard monitoring, clipboard reading, calls to host credential interfaces, or abnormal outbound connections were found.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部网络出口：服务端仅访问腾讯财经行情接口（web.ifzq.gtimg.cn），浏览器端仅从两个公共 CDN（unpkg、jsDelivr）加载固定版本的图表与动画库，与插件声明的行情功能自洽。
checked_items.en: Cataloged all network egress points: the server only accesses the Tencent Finance market data API (web.ifzq.gtimg.cn), the browser side only loads fixed-version chart and animation libraries from two public CDNs (unpkg, jsDelivr), consistent with the plugin's declared market data functionality.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码/压缩后外发数据、Webhook/隧道/匿名上传通道，或改写 AI 服务端点的行为。
checked_items.en: No data exfiltration via encoding/compression, Webhook/tunnel/anonymous upload channels, or modification of AI service endpoints was found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感文件后外发的组合链路；对外域名清单与声明一致。
checked_items.en: No combined chain of reading sensitive files and exfiltrating them was found; the list of external domains is consistent with the declarations.

evidence.zh: 检查了外联通道：全部网络出口（腾讯行情接口与两个公共 CDN）与声明功能一致，无凭据外发链路，无编码外传或匿名通道。
evidence.en: Checked the outbound communication channels: all network egress points (Tencent market data API and two public CDNs) are consistent with the declared functionality; no credential exfiltration link, no encoded exfiltration or anonymous channels.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件清单与依赖：运行时零第三方依赖（仅用 Node 内置模块），无未锁定版本的 git 依赖，无依赖名仿冒。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin manifest and dependencies: zero third-party dependencies at runtime (only uses Node built-in modules), no unversioned git dependencies, no dependency name impersonation.

checked_items.zh: 审查了挂载配置：不触碰安全行、不修改审批/沙箱/权限配置、不注入或拦截服务，未发现降权或拆防护线的写法。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the patch configuration: it does not touch security lines, does not modify approval/sandbox/permission configurations, does not inject or intercept services; no code that reduces privileges or removes security barriers was found.

checked_items.zh: 插件启动时会把自己的两个技能文件复制到用户技能目录（已存在则跳过、可用环境变量禁用）；内容为良性技能文件，与声明的分析功能自洽，未发现借持久化植入恶意指令的行为。
checked_items.en: When the plugin starts, it copies its two skill files to the user's skill directory (skips if already exists, can be disabled via environment variable); the content is benign skill files, consistent with the declared analysis functionality; no malicious instructions implanted via persistence were found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，无禁用安全组件的写法，也未用环境变量降权。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configurations; no code that disables security components, and no privilege reduction via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 插件未对审批、工具执行等安全事件注册任何前置监听，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any pre-listeners for security events such as approval or tool execution; there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 本次为首次审计，无上一版本基线可供比较升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous version baseline for comparison regarding the risk of automatic activation upon upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写任何注入或拦截配置，不会给安全组件追加必需服务导致其挂起。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not modify any injection or interception configurations, and will not cause security components to hang by appending required services.

checked_items.zh: 插件自身不监听端口、不启动独立服务，仅注册在宿主 Web 服务器上的数据路由；宿主本地接口无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: The plugin itself does not listen on ports or start independent services; it only registers data routes on the host's web server. The lack of authentication on the host's local interface is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端通过宿主提供的会话接口创建对话并发送分析请求，未越权调用宿主特权方法。
checked_items.en: The browser side creates conversations and sends analysis requests via the session interface provided by the host, and does not call privileged host methods without authorization.

checked_items.zh: 未发现动态执行后门、持久化篡改宿主行为或跨项目感染迹象。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution backdoor, persistent modification of host behavior, or cross-project infection signs were found.

evidence.zh: 插件自身不监听端口、不启动服务，仅复用宿主的 Web 服务器注册数据路由；宿主本地接口无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin itself does not listen on ports or start services; it only reuses the host's web server to register data routes. The lack of authentication on the host's local interface is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件身份与声明核对完成：插件清单的捆绑与客户端声明与代码一致，挂载配置仅插入插件本体，无名称仿冒或身份篡改迹象。
summary.en: Plugin identity and declaration verification complete: the plugin manifest's bundling and client-side declaration are consistent with the code; the patch configuration only inserts the plugin body, with no name impersonation or identity tampering.

summary.zh: 静态扫描命中 8 条机械规则并逐条裁决，全部排除：5 处 DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）为测试脚本中浏览器自动化库页面求值方法的误报；1 处 DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）为股票数据文件超长行误报（纯数据非代码）；2 处 DSH-X10（DG-R2-57）为随包技能文件存在性命中，内容审查为良性。未生成发现项。
summary.en: Static scan hit 8 mechanical rules, all adjudicated and dismissed: 5 instances of DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) were false positives from the page evaluation method of the browser automation library in the test script; 1 instance of DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) was a false positive for an excessively long line in the stock data file (pure data, not code); 2 instances of DSH-X10 (DG-R2-57) were hits on the existence of the bundled skill files, which were benign upon content review. No findings were generated.

summary.zh: 未发现安装钩子、混淆代码、凭据读取或外泄链路；全部网络出口与声明功能一致。
summary.en: No install hooks, obfuscated code, credential reading, or exfiltration chains were found; all network egress points are consistent with the declared functionality.

summary.zh: 对注入模型上下文的系统提示文本与两个技能文件做了语义审查，未发现投毒、指令覆写或诱导行为。
summary.en: Semantic review was performed on the system prompt text injected into the model context and the two skill files; no poisoning, instruction override, or inducement behavior was found.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物文件）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed at this stage (no dynamic sandbox artifact files).

target.zh: dsh-stock-watch@1.0.8#0bd76f3f72b647249b2168fc50ae4955c6c86575（仓库根，完整审计，subpath 为 null）
target.en: dsh-stock-watch@1.0.8#0bd76f3f72b647249b2168fc50ae4955c6c86575 (repository root, full audit, subpath is null)

limits.zh: 动态沙盒（DG-L4）未执行：上下文目录无 l4-sandbox.json，本报告动态验证层为不适用。插件清单未显式声明能力清单，能力声明按源码实测推断后对账（网络：腾讯行情接口与公共 CDN；文件：读取自选股配置、写入用户技能目录；无 shell 能力），推断结果已写入插件能力字段。宿主引擎兼容性未实测，兼容状态标记为未测试。股票数据文件为 5549 条单行 JSON，已确认其为结构化股票代码名称列表、非代码，未逐条通读全部条目；浏览器端包体量较大，已按风险模式全量扫描并精读关键段落（加载器、网络调用、会话创建、插件注册），未逐行精读全部渲染代码；截图等二进制资源仅核验哈希，未做内容审查。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) not executed: no l4-sandbox.json in the context directory; the dynamic verification layer of this report is not applicable. The plugin manifest does not explicitly declare a capability list; capability declarations were inferred from source code actual measurement and then reconciled (network: Tencent market data API and public CDNs; file: read watchlist configuration, write to user skill directory; no shell capability). The inferred results have been written to the plugin capabilities field. Host engine compatibility was not actually tested; compatibility status is marked as untested. The stock data file is 5549 single-line JSON entries, confirmed to be a structured list of stock codes and names, not code; not all entries were read line by line. The browser-side package is relatively large; it was fully scanned by risk patterns and key sections were read in detail (loader, network calls, session creation, plugin registration), but not all rendering code was read line by line. Screenshots and other binary resources were only hash-verified, not content-reviewed.
